gaps.sentence: Could you look ___ my suitcase while I buy the tickets?
gaps.explanation: look after = take care of; look for = search; look up = check in a reference.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The evidence finally backed ___ his version of events.
gaps.explanation: back up = support with evidence (a claim backs up a story).

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: The kids made ___ a story about a stolen dog.
gaps.explanation: make up = invent (a story, excuse). Compare make up for = compensate.
run out OF something = have none left.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).
